_comment: EXAMPLE config for the READ-ONLY legacy export (Loop 36) — PLACEHOLDERS ONLY. Copy to legacy-export.config.local.json (GIT-IGNORED via *.local.*) and fill real values LOCALLY. auth.mode 'app-certificate' reuses the D6 provider (requires an admin-granted Sites.Selected READ permission on the legacy site); 'token-file' reads an operator-minted delegated token from a git-ignored file. The exporter is GET-only by construction: no writes, no attachment binaries, raw output only under the git-ignored exports/ folder.
